question: Where can I find a hotel that are within 150 kilometers and lie east of the Cabell Gallery, Lexington, VA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cabell Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lexington%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ), 150000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cabell Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lexington%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
